text: how to deal with a female friend trying to ruin a relationship between you and your girlfriend. This is how one of my subscribers started his question to me. So let's go straight to it. The friend is a roommate to my girlfriend and she is in her circle so it's inevitable to cut her off. Probably he meant impossible to cut her off. After some arguments and disagreements between me and my girl, it went for three months, it was clear that someone was stirring the waters. My girl now understands that she is harmful and I ask for her to protect me from her. Boundaries are set but I am still worried because sometimes she sends questionable reels, messages and stuff. She is jealous of our relationship and the way I love my girl. Plus she's into hook-up culture and parties and tries hardly to drug my girl into that. Sometimes I see that my girl is not aware of the situation but sometimes not. It's so confusing and even though boundaries are set, I am still raging and hating towards that female friend. What's the best thing you advise me to do? I am being a little bit sarcastic here and when I read my answer you probably understand why. Hey man, thank you for your question. There are a couple of things to unpack here. First, you are painting the friend of your girlfriend as a bad guy, which she could definitely be. Sabotaging your relationship, talking shit about you behind your back, telling your girlfriend that she deserves someone better than you. But you are omitting one extremely important point here. Your girlfriend is allowing it. Don't be so naive and think that your girlfriend is not aware of the situation, does not understand what is going on, get manipulated and is taken advantage of. No, she most probably realizes what is going on and allows it. So guys, don't be naive. Don't think that your girlfriend is an angel and everybody else around her is just affecting her in a bad way. Once again, in a relationship you are one unit. She chose you and you chose her. So you should be one of the most important people on earth for her. If she's not protecting you, if she allows her friend to speak about you in that tone, if she stays friends with her after that, that shows that you are not that important to her. There are hundreds of things she could do. Warn her not to talk like that about you. And if she continued, block her, move out, find another place to live, not speak to her, you name it. But once again, it seems like she did none of that. Second, three months of arguments and disagreements. Wherever stirred the water, fact is fact. The relationship is not light and easygoing. It is troublesome and for quite a serious period of time. Once again, relationship should be light and easygoing or not at all. As a last resort, you can use yellow-red card principle here. Talk to your girlfriend, explain what bothers you, and then observe. If she does show you with her actions that she understood and she wants to be with you, respect you and your boundaries, which would most probably include cutting that friend out of her life, then maybe there is a chance. If that does not happen, you are better off ending this relationship. To that he wrote, thanks man, I really appreciate your efforts and your outstanding support. I made it clear since a month or so and things are going quite well. Okay guys, so this was a video for today. My name is Ilyas Abdullin, thanks a lot and bye.
